cases.id: deleteKey and renameKey on a repeated key take every spelling [1]
cases.note: plist reads a `<key>` written more than once as one entry, the last spelling's value at the first's place. A delete or rename takes every spelling; one that took the first left the key reading on.
cases.source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>a</key>
  <integer>1</integer>
  <key>b</key>
  <string>x</string>
  <!-- again -->
  <key>a</key>
  <string>last</string>
</dict>
</plist>

expect.source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>b</key>
  <string>x</string>
</dict>
</plist>
